machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory, macOS 26.6.2
scope: Replace every VAE decoder convolution (3x3, 1x1, and nearest-2x upsample plus 3x3) with MPSGraph FP32 NHWC convolution; now the default, QI_DISABLE_VAE_MPSGRAPH_CONV=1 restores the custom kernels

diagnosis.custom_kernel_throughput_tflops: about 1.6-1.7 FP32 at every up block (about 16% of the 10.6 TFLOP/s peak), estimated from the F5 dispatch profile and layer FLOPs
causes: per-element integer division and modulo to decode pixel, channel, and tap in the implicit-GEMM gather
K ordered channel-major over OIHW taps, so neighbouring lanes read different pixels instead of contiguous HWC channels
sixteen SIMD groups each computing four 8x8 blocks: five threadgroup loads per four MMAs

external_probe.interpretation: Above-peak FP32 conv throughput with below-CPU-FP32 error indicates a fast convolution algorithm computed carefully in FP32, not reduced precision.
external_probe.caveat: GPU showed about 30% desktop load during the throughput probe

implementation.graph: NHWC FP32 placeholder -> optional resizeTensor nearest 2x (centerResult YES, alignCorners NO) -> convolution2D (explicit padding, OIHW weights) -> bias addition
implementation.weights: Bound in place from the read-only Safetensors mapping as flat MPSNDArrays at their file offsets and reshaped to OIHW in the graph; no copy or repack
implementation.graph_cache: One graph per distinct layer shape, created on first use
implementation.command_buffer: Production decode wraps its single command buffer as an MPSCommandBuffer; MPSGraph may commit-and-continue, so the reported GPU timestamp is fragmented and wall time is authoritative

timing.memory_note: About 2.15 GB more peak footprint, attributed to MPSGraph internal scratch; the VAE phase runs after the transformer mapping is released.

end_to_end_1024.command: generate-1024-cache-dit models/qwen-image-2.1-all-fp16-v4.qipack MODEL_DIR OUT 'A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading ''MEET ME AT SUNSET'', bold geometric lettering.' 0.16 1301 40
end_to_end_1024.visual: CASABLANCA, MEET ME AT, and SUNSET exact
end_to_end_1024.comparison: Previous best 145.18 s with a 10.230 s VAE phase; the VAE phase fell by 7.39 s and the whole run by 9.63 s. The PNG checksum differs because the decoder's FP32 summation order changed; the official 1024 oracle error fell from 6.47e-07 to 2.25e-07.
end_to_end_1024.power_state: AC Power; battery 100%; charged; GPU idle before the run

decision: Accepted as default. The F5 closing condition asked for an equally accurate FP32 framework path; this is more accurate at every oracle and 3.9x faster at 1024.
